tabs.label: Dec. 2021
tabs.title: Henan Company Established
tabs.description: Grand-Hope New Materials Factory is located in Luohe City, Henan Province, covering an area of 105 acres with a factory building of 40,000 square meters. The company employs over 100 staff members and has a total investment of over 200 million yuan. It produces over 20,000 sets of insulation materials annually, which are widely applied in fields such as silicon carbide crystal growth and epitaxy, silicon semiconductor, and optical fiber.

tabs.label: Jan. 2022
tabs.title: Begin R&D
tabs.description: Grand-Hope New Materials has established deep technical collaborations with universities, research institutes, and other teams, continuously innovating, improving, and refining the manufacturing technology of high-performance carbon fiber composite insulation materials with independent intellectual property rights. The company has a significant competitive advantage in the industry.

tabs.label: Dec. 2022
tabs.title: Developed with proprietary technology
tabs.description: Following the successful development of Grand-Hope New Materials, our products now outperform the vast majority of similar products in the high-temperature thermal field.

tabs.label: Mar. 2023
tabs.title: Practical Verification Passed
tabs.description: By integrating core formulas, processes, and customized automated equipment, we provide stable domestically produced products.

tabs.label: Mar. 2023
tabs.title: Shanghai Branch Established
tabs.description: Grand-Hope New Materials is a technology-driven enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and sale of high-performance carbon fiber composite insulation materials (commonly known as hard felt). The company boasts a top-tier technical team in the field and extensive industry experience.

tabs.label: 2021年12月

tabs.label: 2022年1月
tabs.title: 开始研发

tabs.label: 2022年12月
tabs.title: 自主技术研发成功
tabs.description: 冠合新材料成功研发后，我们的产品在高温热场中性能优于绝大多数同类产品。

tabs.label: 2023年3月
tabs.title: 通过实际验证
tabs.description: 通过整合核心配方、工艺和定制自动化设备，我们提供稳定的国产化产品。

tabs.description: 冠合新材料是一家以技术驱动为核心的企业，专注于高性能碳纤维复合保温材料（俗称硬毡）的研发、生产和销售。公司拥有该领域顶尖的技术团队和丰富的行业经验。

tabs.label: 2021年12月

tabs.description: Grand-Hope新材料工場は河南省漯河市に位置し、敷地面積105ムー、工場建物40,000平方メートルを有しています。従業員100名以上、総投資額2億元以上。年間20,000セット以上の断熱材を生産し、炭化ケイ素結晶成長・エピタキシー、シリコン半導体、光ファイバーなどの分野で広く採用されています。
